reported_claims.text: A large group of heavily armed assailants attacked the National Guard near Sanam, Tillaberi region; the provisional toll is at least 13 guards killed and 20 wounded, and a search for the assailants is under way.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Niger defence ministry (statement on public television)

reported_claims.text: At least 37 civilians were killed in an ambush by unidentified armed men near Tera, Tillaberi, on 12 November.

unknowns: Exact date of the attack (reported as Thursday)
reassessment_triggers: Claim of responsibility by an Al-Qaeda or Islamic State affiliate

update_history.summary: Draft collected for editorial review; not yet published.

title: Armed assailants kill at least 13 National Guard members in western Niger
summary: Niger's defence ministry said a large group of heavily armed assailants attacked National Guard members taking part in an anti-jihadist operation near the village of Sanam in the Tillaberi region, near the Mali and Burkina Faso borders, killing at least 13 and wounding 20. No group had been named as responsible in the reporting reviewed. The attack follows an ambush near Tera in the same region on 12 November that killed at least 37 civilians.
impact_assessment: Observed: significant losses for Nigerien security forces in the tri-border area. Potential: further deterioration of security in western Niger and pressure on the military government's counter-insurgency campaign.
priority_rationale: MODERATE: a deadly attack in an ongoing Sahel insurgency; single wire-based source so far.
monitoring_actions: Track attacks in the Mali-Burkina Faso-Niger tri-border area

sources.title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
